Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestP.pl: Jeśli SPOJRZYSZ na jego plecy, widać, że Cornelius jest zrobiony z...

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.en: ...looks different to the cane Gripp has now.

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.en: ...that are two wheel spokes joined together.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.pl: ...że to dwie szprychy koła połączone razem.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.en: ...that isn't from the ship's wheel at all.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.pl: ...że to wcale nie pochodzi z koła sterowego.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/RequestS.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Uh, yeah, there [i]is[/i] something - or [h]someone[/h] - that I'd like to ask you about.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Yy, tak, [i]jest[/i] coś - albo [h]ktoś[/h] - o co chciałbym cię zapytać.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: His appearance.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jego wygląd.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: There's one thing I don't understand - if Mortuga didn't intend to [i]use[/i] the map, why did he keep it [i]around?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jest jedna rzecz, której nie rozumiem - jeśli Mortuga nie zamierzał [i]używać[/i] mapy, czemu ją [i]zatrzymał?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I don't suppose we'll ever find out-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Chyba się nigdy nie dowiemy-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I think I know.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Chyba wiem.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: ...you do?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: ...naprawdę?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Mhm. There's a good reason why Mortuga didn't want to follow the map.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Mhm. Jest dobry powód, dla którego Mortuga nie chciał podążyć za mapą.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He'd already followed it.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Już za nią podążył.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He'd found out the map was a hoax.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Odkrył, że mapa to oszustwo.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He'd decided it was too dangerous.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Uznał, że to zbyt niebezpieczne.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Why wouldn't Mortuga want to follow the map?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czemu Mortuga nie chciałby podążyć za mapą?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He'd found out the map was a hoax.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Odkrył, że mapa to oszustwo.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He'd decided it was too dangerous.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Uznał, że to zbyt niebezpieczne.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He'd already followed it.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Już za nią podążył.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: ...what makes you say that?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: ...czemu tak mówisz?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: This is a film of Magnus Mortuga and a woman named Felicia Stonetop.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: To film przedstawiający Magnusa Mortugę i kobietę imieniem Felicia Stonetop.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I don't think think he looks... quite like he's supposed to?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Chyba nie wygląda... tak, jak powinien?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: They're talking about their plans to follow the map.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Rozmawiają o swoich planach podążenia za mapą.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Remarkable...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Niezwykłe...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: No - in fact, it's not a submarine at all.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Nie - w rzeczywistości to wcale nie jest łódź podwodna.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: The ship was called the [i]Dearest Selena[/i], but it belonged to Felicia Stonetop.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Statek nazywał się [i]Dearest Selena[/i], ale należał do Felicii Stonetop.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: She was the Captain and Mortuga was her helmsman. See, he's at the top there, manning the wheel.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ona była kapitanem, a Mortuga jej sternikiem. Widzisz, tam na górze, przy kole sterowym.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: You know, that's been on his desk since I arrived-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Wiecie, to stało na jego biurku, odkąd przybyłem-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: -and I [i]never once thought[/i] to ask him about it.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: -i [i]ani razu nie przyszło mi do głowy[/i], żeby go o to zapytać.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: So, okay - we know they [h]intended[/h] to follow the map...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: No dobra - wiemy, że [h]zamierzali[/h] podążyć za mapą...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: ...but do we know if they actually [h]managed[/h] it?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: ...ale czy wiemy, czy faktycznie im się [h]udało?[/h]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Good point. Making plans is one thing, but a successful expedition is quite another.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Słuszna uwaga. Planowanie to jedno, a udana wyprawa to zupełnie co innego.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I can't be sure, but there was something we found here on the submarine...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Nie mogę być pewna, ale znaleźliśmy tu, na łodzi podwodnej, coś...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Something that suggests to me Mortuga actually [h]did[/h] reach the centre of the map.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Coś, co sugeruje mi, że Mortudze faktycznie [h]udało się[/h] dotrzeć do środka mapy.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: What's [h]that[/h] got to do with it?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Co [h]to[/h] ma z tym wspólnego?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en:
Oh yeah, look at that!
I think you might be right.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl:
O tak, spójrz na to!
Chyba masz rację.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: But why didn't he just tell me...?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ale czemu po prostu mi nie powiedział...?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Well, buoys are normally put in place to mark a position.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Cóż, boje zwykle umieszcza się, żeby oznaczyć pozycję.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: The position of something else in the ocean?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Pozycję czegoś innego w oceanie?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: It has to be. Think about it-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Musi tak być. Pomyśl o tym-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: If the buoy wasn't attached to anything, then it would've floated away, making the map worthless.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Gdyby boja nie była do niczego przyczepiona, odpłynęłaby, przez co mapa byłaby bezwartościowa.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: It was only because it was attached to something [h]else[/h] at the time.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Została na miejscu tylko dlatego, że była wtedy przyczepiona do czegoś [h]innego[/h].
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: So - if they [i]found[/i] the buoy when they went to the centre of the map...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czyli - jeśli [i]znaleźli[/i] boję, gdy dotarli do środka mapy...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: What did he find in the ocean that was such a big secret?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Co on znalazł w oceanie, co było taką wielką tajemnicą?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Surely it wasn't just... [h]this?[/h] It hardly seems like anything at all...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Chyba to nie było tylko... [h]to?[/h] To ledwie coś przypomina...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Now you mention it, they don't match at all.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Teraz, kiedy o tym mówisz, wcale do siebie nie pasują.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: What a thing to say, you've only just [i]met[/i] him!
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Coś takiego powiedzieć, przecież dopiero co go [i]poznałaś![/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Wait - was that filmed here on the submarine...?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czekaj - to zostało nakręcone tutaj, na łodzi podwodnej...?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Ha-[i]ha![/i] Have [i]at[/i] you! I've been looking forward to this part.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ha-[i]ha![/i] No to [i]dawaj![/i] Czekałem na tę część.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en:
[i]Oh-[/i]
Right.
I'd forgotten you'd seen that.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl:
[i]Ach-[/i]
No tak.
Zapomniałem, że to widzieliście.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: The one [i]you've[/i] got is a different shape... and it's made of wood.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ten, który [i]ty[/i] masz, ma inny kształt... i jest zrobiony z drewna.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: It's a record of service from your shop. Not the one here in the [i]submarine[/i], but the [i]real[/i] one in the town.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: To zapis usługi z twojego sklepu. Nie tego tutaj, na [i]łodzi podwodnej[/i], ale tego [i]prawdziwego[/i] w mieście.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I did.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Tak, zrobiłem to.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Why?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Dlaczego?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: [i]Map interpreted by: Godrik Gripp. For customer: Magnus Mortuga.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: [i]Mapę zinterpretował: Godrik Gripp. Dla klienta: Magnus Mortuga.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Eh... it's all there in black and white, I suppose.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Eee... chyba wszystko jest tam napisane czarno na białym.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Yes [i]indeed[/i] - some time ago, Mortuga came into my shop.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Tak, [i]rzeczywiście[/i] - jakiś czas temu Mortuga wszedł do mojego sklepu.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: [h]This[/h] is what you're grilling me about?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: [h]To[/h] jest to, o co mnie przypiekacie?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: It's marked with an X, but there's nothing in the way of coordinates-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jest oznaczona krzyżykiem, ale nie ma żadnych współrzędnych-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: The problem was -afterwards, all my other work suddenly seemed... [i]banal.[/i] Hm!
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Problem w tym, że -potem cała reszta mojej pracy nagle wydała się... [i]banalna.[/i] Hm!
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: A disagreement? About [i]what?[/i] Where to take the [i]submarine?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Spór? O [i]co?[/i] O to, dokąd popłynąć [i]łodzią podwodną?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: [i]Interpret[/i] it?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: [i]Zinterpretować[/i] ją?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: -nor are there any apparent [i]landmarks[/i] - given that it's just describing an area of ocean.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: -ani żadnych widocznych [i]punktów orientacyjnych[/i] - w końcu opisuje po prostu obszar oceanu.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: So - how did you work it out?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Więc - jak to rozgryzłeś?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Why [i]would[/i] the two canes look different though?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ale czemu te dwie laski [i]miałyby[/i] w ogóle wyglądać inaczej?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Gripp made a new cane after arriving on the submarine.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Gripp zrobił nową laskę po przybyciu na łódź podwodną.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: The drawing of the original cane is inaccurate.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Rysunek oryginalnej laski jest niedokładny.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Gripp painted the original cane to look different.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Gripp pomalował oryginalną laskę, żeby wyglądała inaczej.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Why does Gripp's current cane look different to the original?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czemu obecna laska Grippa wygląda inaczej niż oryginalna?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: ...it [i]grabbed me[/i], and it didn't let go. For two weeks, it was all I thought about.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: ...to mnie [i]wciągnęło[/i] i nie puszczało. Przez dwa tygodnie tylko o tym myślałem.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I was so focused on it I barely slept - easily the most thrilling job I'd ever taken on.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Byłem tak skupiony, że ledwie spałem - zdecydowanie najbardziej ekscytujące zlecenie, jakiego się kiedykolwiek podjąłem.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I even waived the payment - I couldn't in good conscience charge for something I'd enjoyed so much.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Nawet zrezygnowałem z zapłaty - nie mógłbym w spokoju sumienia liczyć sobie za coś, co sprawiło mi tyle radości.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I began to daydream of that thrilling feeling - that pursuit of the unknown...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Zacząłem marzyć o tym ekscytującym uczuciu - o tym pościgu za nieznanym...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Something [i]about[/i] that map, the mystery of it, the feeling of chasing down the unknown...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Coś [i]w[/i] tej mapie, jej tajemniczość, uczucie pogoni za nieznanym...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: It led me to eventually close up shop and head out in my balloon - on a voyage of my own...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ostatecznie doprowadziło mnie to do zamknięcia sklepu i wyruszenia moim balonem - we własną podróż...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Which, as you know, ended rather abruptly.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Która, jak wiecie, zakończyła się dość nagle.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: The drawing of the original cane is inaccurate.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Rysunek oryginalnej laski jest niedokładny.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Ah - but to be pulled from the ocean by [i]Magnus Mortuga himself[/i], and to find that [i]very same map[/i] laying on his desk...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ach - ale zostać wyłowionym z oceanu przez [i]samego Magnusa Mortugę[/i] i znaleźć [i]dokładnie tę samą mapę[/i] leżącą na jego biurku...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I asked him at [i]once[/i] if he'd ever followed the map to the coordinates... and he said he hadn't.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Zapytałem go [i]od razu[/i], czy kiedykolwiek podążył za mapą do tych współrzędnych... powiedział, że nie.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I was disappointed at first, but then I realised - we had the submarine, we could still go! Right now!
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Na początku byłem rozczarowany, ale potem zdałem sobie sprawę - mieliśmy łódź podwodną, wciąż mogliśmy popłynąć! Zaraz teraz!
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He was very strong, you see.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Widzicie, był bardzo stanowczy.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: He showed me the map and asked if I'd be able to interpret it for some voyage he was planning.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Pokazał mi mapę i zapytał, czy potrafiłbym ją zinterpretować na potrzeby jakiejś podróży, którą planował.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: My request denied, I soon found myself opening a new branch of Gripp's Emporium right here in the engine room.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Po odmowie mojej prośbie, wkrótce otworzyłem nową filię Emporium Grippa właśnie tutaj, w maszynowni.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: [i]Which[/i] -  of course, necessitated the construction of a new Cornelius Cane.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: [i]Co[/i] - rzecz jasna, wymagało zbudowania nowego Corneliusa Cane'a.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: There's a [i]faint[/i] resemblance, I suppose...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jest [i]nikłe[/i] podobieństwo, jak sądzę...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Gripp made a new cane after arriving on the submarine.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Gripp zrobił nową laskę po przybyciu na łódź podwodną.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: ...but aren't the - wheel spokes a fair bit [i]shorter[/i] than Cornelius?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: ...ale czy szprychy koła nie są sporo [i]krótsze[/i] niż Cornelius?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Right.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: No właśnie.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Gripp painted the original cane to look different.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Gripp pomalował oryginalną laskę, żeby wyglądała inaczej.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: What a [h]damning[/h] accusation.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Cóż za [h]druzgocące[/h] oskarżenie.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Yes, I made a new cane, and yes, it's made of wood.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Tak, zrobiłem nową laskę, i tak, jest zrobiona z drewna.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Where are you [h]going[/h] with this??
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Do czego to [h]zmierza??[/h]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Ask about where the wood came from.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Zapytaj, skąd wzięło się drewno.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Ask about what happened to the original cane.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Zapytaj, co się stało z oryginalną laską.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Ask about why Gripp wants a cane in the first place.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Zapytaj, czemu Gripp w ogóle chce mieć laskę.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Gripp made a new wooden cane...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Gripp zrobił nową drewnianą laskę...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: What happened to the [i]original[/i] cane?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Co się stało z [i]oryginalną[/i] laską?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I... left him at home - when I went off in my balloon.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ja... zostawiłem go w domu - kiedy wyruszyłem moim balonem.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: ...I thought I ought to leave the trappings of the brand behind me, but it wasn't to be, clearly.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: ...pomyślałem, że powinienem zostawić za sobą atrybuty marki, ale najwyraźniej nie było mi to pisane.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Why do you want a cane in the [i]first[/i] place?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czemu [i]w ogóle[/i] chcesz mieć laskę?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Mr Gripp's [i]always[/i] had Cornelius Cane as his sidekick-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Pan Gripp [i]zawsze[/i] miał Corneliusa Cane'a jako swojego towarzysza-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: -it's an integral part of the branding for Mr Gripp's Emporium.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: -to integralna część wizerunku Emporium Pana Grippa.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Where did the [i]wood[/i] come from?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Skąd wzięło się [i]drewno?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en:
I, uh...
I forget.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl:
Ja, yy...
Zapomniałem.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: [i]Remarkable![/i] This is quite the revelation!
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: [i]Niezwykłe![/i] To doprawdy objawienie!
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Wait, you're saying you [i]didn't know[/i] the wood came from the wheel?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czekaj, mówisz, że [i]nie wiedziałeś[/i], że drewno pochodzi z koła?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Of course I didn't! Why would I know anything [h]about[/h] that?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Oczywiście, że nie! Skąd miałbym cokolwiek o tym [h]wiedzieć?[/h]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Because you've also got the [i]rest[/i] of the broken wheel pieces.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Bo masz też [i]resztę[/i] połamanych kawałków koła.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Because [i]you[/i] were the one who repaired the broken wheel.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Bo to [i]ty[/i] naprawiałeś złamane koło.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Because you were the one who sold the [i]original wheel[/i] to Mortuga.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Bo to ty sprzedałeś Mortudze [i]oryginalne koło.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Why might Gripp know the wood came from the broken wheel?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czemu Gripp mógłby wiedzieć, że drewno pochodzi ze złamanego koła?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Because you were the one who sold the [i]original wheel[/i] to Mortuga.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Bo to ty sprzedałeś Mortudze [i]oryginalne koło.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Because [i]you[/i] were the one who repaired the broken wheel.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Bo to [i]ty[/i] naprawiałeś złamane koło.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Because you've also got the [i]rest[/i] of the broken wheel pieces.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Bo masz też [i]resztę[/i] połamanych kawałków koła.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: So Gripp, I  have to ask - do you know anything about how the ship's wheel was broken?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Więc Gripp, muszę zapytać - wiesz coś o tym, jak zostało złamane koło sterowe?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Yes, I was there when the wheel was broken.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Tak, byłem tam, kiedy koło zostało złamane.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: In fact, Mortuga and I... we, uh - we broke it.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Właściwie, Mortuga i ja... my, yy - my je złamaliśmy.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: [h]You[/h] broke it?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: [h]Wy[/h] je złamaliście?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: There'd been... a disagreement. It's nothing, really, not important-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Doszło do... nieporozumienia. To nic takiego, naprawdę, nieważne-
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I was... trying to take control of the wheel, and Mortuga [i]forcibly wrenched[/i] it out my grip.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ja... próbowałem przejąć kontrolę nad kołem, a Mortuga [i]siłą wyrwał[/i] mi je z rąk.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Wait - you tried to steer the submarine? Without permission?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czekaj - próbowałeś sterować łodzią podwodną? Bez pozwolenia?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Something - like that...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Coś... w tym stylu...
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: [i]...Cornelius?[/i] What about him?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: [i]...Cornelius?[/i] A co z nim?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: His appearance.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jego wygląd.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: His name.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jego imię.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: His function.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jego funkcja.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: What's weird about Cornelius Cane?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Co jest dziwnego w Corneliusie Cane?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: By employing every ounce of my skill. By working [i]harder[/i] than I'd ever worked.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Wykorzystując każdą odrobinę mojego kunsztu. Pracując [i]ciężej[/i], niż kiedykolwiek wcześniej.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: His name.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jego imię.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: But Mortuga told me we would be doing no such thing.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ale Mortuga powiedział mi, że nic takiego nie będziemy robić.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: In fact, we weren't to be navigating [h]anywhere.[/h]
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Właściwie mieliśmy [h]nigdzie[/h] nie nawigować.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: Instead, he seemed insistant in hovering near the Silkwirm coast, like something was keeping him tethered to it.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Zamiast tego uparcie kręcił się w pobliżu wybrzeża Silkwirm, jakby coś trzymało go tam na uwięzi.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: So... you tried steering the submarine yourself?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Czyli... sam próbowałeś sterować łodzią podwodną?
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I'd convinced myself it was what Mortuga secretly wanted, even if he was refusing to admit it.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Przekonałem samego siebie, że to właśnie potajemnie chciał Mortuga, nawet jeśli nie chciał się do tego przyznać.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: I thought a little nudge might be just what he needed - get him out of his comfort zone, you know.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Pomyślałem, że mały impuls to może być dokładnie to, czego potrzebował - wyrwać go ze strefy komfortu, rozumiecie.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: His function.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Jego funkcja.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.en: But as I've already admitted, it didn't go to plan.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.pl: Ale jak już przyznałem, nie poszło zgodnie z planem.
Conversation/Gripp 05 SUSPICION/Section.speaker: Gripp
